name: Vocoder
brief: Channel vocoder analyzing a modulator to shape a carrier signal.
description:
Splits both modulator and carrier through parallel bandpass filter
banks (4-32 bands). Envelope followers on the modulator bands control
the amplitude of corresponding carrier bands, transferring the spectral shape.
tips: Use speech as modulator and a rich synth (saw wave) as carrier for classic robot voice.

inputs.name: modulator
inputs.doc: The signal whose spectral envelope is extracted (typically voice).

inputs.name: carrier
inputs.doc: The signal being shaped (typically a synth or noise).
